up: List IC50 values in nM for compounds tested against human acetylcholinesterase (CHEMBL1914) where the compound has a canonical SMILES and the activity has an associated PubMed ID or DOI. For each matching record, return the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, the PubMed ID or DOI from the document, the assay description, and the target name and organism. List each compound only once.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1914'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL);
